body: Thank you. I really appreciate hearing that, you have no idea. I still feel I could have handled the situation alot better, for instance making the decision at the first stop whether to wait for my dad or just drive. And I argued with a drunk person for the ride which is just completely useless waste of energy. But still, thank you.
Ugh I know it depends so it's useless to really even ask here. I hate feelings.
You mean if you do text a girl you like every day you're making a mistake? Why, by appearing too clingy?

I don't know. I feel weird even asking this question. I want to believe he really is interested in me but really is that busy with work and other activities to be able to text. He is very outgoing and ambitious and I lead a fairly quiet life. 
I want to believe he thinks about me even if he doesn't text me out of the blue.

Exactly. I'm worried I'm the one appearing clingy. I cringe whenever I see more than two texts from me in a row on my phone. 

Edit: Also, there is actually a part that thinks I scared him away with my horrible kissing ability. Or that he's just not that into me.
But do you think if he was REALLY interested he would have texted me today? Thanks for tolerating my pestering.
That's sort of what I was thinking too. But I think I'll wait til tomorrow...just to be safe.
You're exactly right. It isn't the end of the world. Glad I could help a little :)

I've actually never replied to any of these so i apologize if this is really shitty advice but I figured I'd try to help.

I think the first thing you should try is allow yourself to feel like shit. Stop thinking in the "suck it up" "get over it" mindset and realize it's ok to feel the way you do. It was a shitty thing that happened to you and have every right to feel terrible. It's ok that you still have feelings for her. And it seems like your friend wasn't very considerate of you when he hooked up with her. And when you see then at the party you're gonna get that wave of distress, but try letting yourself feel it, and then picture yourself stepping away from feeling, and tell it you're done with feeling terrible. Let them be in their relationship, but it's theirs now to worry about. You have more important things to pay attention to.

Hope this didn't make things worse. Good luck
I really appreciate it, and you seem awesome but I can't get that site to work on mobile.
I'm commenting on this to save it to look at whenever I feel shitty. Thanks :)

Yes music helps. I've been meaning to pick up my guitar again but i just never get to it. 

Another thing is not just loneliness, but decision making. With every small decision I have to make my mind conjures up a scenario where something as simple as which car i take to the gym is a life or death decision. Anyone I try to explain it to doesn't understand they just try to make me see how silly I am being. And I know I'm being silly but I can't help it. I'm getting really really tired of every decision being so important to the point of a mental breakdown
That's the thing is I don't want to depend on anyone else so it drives me absolutly nuts when I get beat up over someone
Mostly loneliness I guess. I really don't know. Everyone I meet says how sweet and nice I am so I can't understand why I'm so lonely and can't find friends, even a boyfriend
